verdict.rationale: Machine-to-machine credentials are a fair axis for an auth product, but the evidence pack never documents a client-credentials flow or a way to issue service credentials in Supabase Auth. The only related items are adjacent building blocks: passing self-minted or third-party JWTs via the accessToken option, and custom access token hooks. These do not count as the product issuing M2M credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue machine-to-machine credentials (client-credentials flow) so backend services and agents authenticate without a human in the loop
